thread:
alex: Quick sync — I opened a tiny Terraform PR that tweaks the Deployment for inference-api to make rollouts safer. Changes: minReadySeconds 5 -> 15, maxUnavailable 25% -> 0, maxSurge 25% -> 10%. PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/4567. Anyone see gotchas with HPA/scale-to-zero or secret rotations?

maria: Skimming the PR. FYI the k8s module sets the readinessProbe via the chart values. If readinessProbe timing < minReadySeconds it can make pods appear 'not ready' longer. What does the probe look like?

jon: HPA counts ready pods for scaling decisions, so increasing minReadySeconds delays when a new pod is eligible for target metrics. That can transiently affect scale-up under spike, but for steady traffic 10-15s is usually safe.

alex: Current readinessProbe: ```yaml
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 5
  periodSeconds: 2
  failureThreshold: 3
``` So it typically becomes ready within ~7s.

ci-bot: terraform plan: module.k8s.deployment.inference-api will be updated
- min_ready_seconds: 5 -> 15
- max_unavailable: 25% -> 0
- max_surge: 25% -> 10%
Plan: 0 to add, 0 to destroy, 1 to change.

maria: Also check PodDisruptionBudget (PDB) minAvailable. If PDB requires too many available replicas and maxUnavailable=0, rollingUpdate can stall on drains. What's the PDB set to?

alex: PDB is `minAvailable: 75%` (we run 4 replicas) — that means at least 3 must be available, so only 1 can be taken down at a time.

jon: With 4 replicas and minAvailable 75% = 3, combined with maxSurge 10% (~0), rollouts will be conservative. If we need faster canary, we can do a separate -canary deployment or temporarily relax the PDB.

maria: Note for GPU-backed node pools: maxSurge can create scheduling failures if no nodes have free GPUs. Are these CPU-only pods?

alex: CPU-only. I'll adjust the PR: set minReadySeconds -> 12 (not 15) and add a PR note to notify the HPA owners. Also will call out that secrets/KMS are unaffected.

srebot: deploy-bot: scheduled a non-prod canary rollout to cluster `infra-canary` in 30m. Monitor `inference-api.latency.p50` and `pod.restarts` during the window.

sam-oncall: I'll watch the canary dashboards. Ping me if error_rate > 1% or restart_count > 2 within any 5m window.

alex: Thanks — merging the minor tweak after CI. I'll follow up in the PR with the canary timeline and a short roll-back playbook.
